messages:
Maya: opened PR to refine audit export docs and add a short migration note for older SDK users. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523
Jordan: legal note: don't promise deletion by an exact date. prefer: 'retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law.'
Sam: heads-up: older SDKs used `retention_days`. new SDK uses `retention_policy` (string). i'll add a migration snippet and both py + curl samples.
Priya: add a short redaction sentence: customers can request exports with sensitive fields redacted. keep implementation details out.
Maya: will reword per Jordan and add Priya's note + migration section. adding checklist item for SDK snippet smoke test.
Sam: proposed examples for the docs:
```
# Python (current SDK)
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-abc', retention_policy='audit:60d', redacted=True)
print(resp.url)
```

Older SDK migration note:
```
# Before (older SDK)
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-abc', retention_days=60)
# After (new SDK)
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-abc', retention_policy='audit:60d')
```

curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct-abc","retention_policy":"audit:60d","redacted":true}'
```
Jordan: add cross-ref to SOC2 FAQ and a short caveat: 'exported data may be subject to legal hold or regulatory retention requirements.'
Maya: added the SOC2 FAQ link and the legal caveat. removed any infra specifics per Priya.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/523/export-migration 
Preview expires in 7 days. :sparkles:
Priya: suggestion: include a tiny troubleshooting bullet: if export URL 403s, check tenant permissions and export role.
Sam: added. Also flagged to engineering to run the snippet in CI smoke tests.
Jordan: +1 pending final legal pass.
Maya: thanks everyone will merge after legal signs off and update the changelog.
